zh.summary: 内置 DSH 更新至 0.2.1-rc.3，恢复新会话草稿，并统一归档会话页面的视觉样式。
highlights: 内核：采用官方 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，并更新兼容该内核的默认插件。
新会话：通过新会话入口或 Ctrl+N 返回尚未发送的草稿时，保留已输入内容。
插件入口：左侧栏、会话视图和右侧栏的“更多”菜单支持浏览和创建插件。
聊天管理：归档会话页面沿用官方设置页的排版、分组与明暗主题样式。
数据导入：写入前检查会话压缩格式与所选内核配置，避免导入后会话无法加载。
upgradeNotes: 升级前正常退出应用并备份重要数据；升级保留现有会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。
acknowledgements: 感谢 [DeepSeek Harness 上游维护者](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3) 提供本次内核更新。

en.summary: Updates bundled DSH to 0.2.1-rc.3, restores new-session drafts and aligns the archived-session page with the settings style.
highlights: Core: adopts official DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and updates the default plugins to compatible releases.
New session: returning to an unsent draft through New Session or Ctrl+N preserves the text already entered.
Plugin entry points: the More menus in the left sidebar, conversation view and right sidebar let you browse and create plugins.
Chat Manager: the archived-session page follows the layout, grouping and light/dark styling of the official settings page.
Data import: checks session compression against existing files and the selected core configuration before writing, preventing imports that make sessions unloadable.
upgradeNotes: Exit normally and back up important data before upgrading. Sessions, settings, credentials, plugins and the workspace are preserved.
acknowledgements: Thanks to the [DeepSeek Harness upstream maintainers](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3) for this core update.
